title: UiSchemaRelation
description: Side-link relation create contract. from_table_id is the one side (parent); to_table_id is the child that holds fk_column_id, a real FOREIGN KEY column already in Postgres. Registry only: declaring a relation never issues DDL and never creates a junction table. Many-to-many is out of scope until ids are globally unique.

to_table_id.description: Child schema_tables.id; the table that holds the key column

fk_column_id.description: schema_columns.id of the child FK column; must reference the parent table

cardinality.description: one_to_one requires the key column to be UNIQUE in Postgres
